description: This source file defines the class BlockingBiConsumer, which implements a thread-safe, blocking version of a BiConsumer, enabling synchronized handling of results and exceptions in concurrent Java code.

classes.name: BlockingBiConsumer
classes.description: A class that implements BiConsumer and ResultGetter, providing blocking behavior until a result or exception is available.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a value and a throwable, storing them and counting down the latch to unblock any waiting thread.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Waits for the result to be available with a timeout, then returns the value or throws an exception if one was provided.
